stops.note: meaning "pounds, kneads"; root of the Hindi imperative champo
from "chāmpnā", to press or knead the body
British visitors adopted the practice and word from Indian bathhouses
stops.meaning: to massage the body while bathing

stops.note: narrowed over time to mean washing the hair specifically
stops.meaning: a liquid soap for washing hair

current_meaning: a liquid or cream product used to wash hair
